# Finding the lamp

The lamp stands by the door. Lamp oil[^oil] is kept in the shed.

[^oil]: Paraffin oil, from the village shop.

## Lighting

Strike a match and turn the LAMP up slowly, so the lamp **light** grows.

| Part | Note |
| --- | --- |
| Wick | Trim it before each lamp is lit |
| Glass | Clean it when the lamp is cold |

```sh
lamp --trim
```

<details>
<summary>Storing</summary>

Keep a spare lamp in the cellar.

</details>
